verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee is driven entirely through an API-key-authenticated HTTP API and an official CLI, including cron-based scheduled jobs, so it runs non-interactively and suits scripted automation. Nothing in the evidence documents CI use specifically, such as pipeline examples, non-interactive auth via environment variables, or exit-code behavior. The schedule command is also a gated advanced feature. Missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline integration docs (e.g. GitHub Actions examples), documented non-interactive CLI auth and exit-code semantics, independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
